name: Singularity RPG
detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in the hypothetical future wherein AI achieves General Intelligence and seeks to eliminate humanity. Singularity RPG is a hand-drawn, story-rich, mysterious, dark-cozy, classic-style role playing game with simple controls, turn-based battles, and choose-your-adventure elements. Unravel the mystery.

Harmony has been working on a mycological hybrid artificial general intelligence for YEARS, and she's soooo close! She's also late for her anniversary dinner. Leaving her lab tech, Rob, to close down for the day, you'll help Harmony put together a bouquet of wildflowers as a consolation for her girlfriend, Melody, who surely has dinner waiting. 

Explore Stamets Point, your everyday Pacific Northwest town, as dusk approaches. Then buckle up. 

When things go haywire, you'll control Melody as she avoids corrupted robots in an otherwise typical RPG-controlled game. Choose your words carefully when seeking help, as they'll determine the fates of many. Test your mettle in turn-based, front-view RPG battles with first-person-shooter pixel animations combined with particle effects. 

What happened to Rob at the lab? 

What's gotten into these killer robots?

And why is ONE of them seemingly unaffected?

Enjoy the Singularity RPG soundtrack, written and performed by German composer, Martin Biesecke.

short_description: Classic-style, top-down, story-rich, 2D role playing game. Explore, choose, discover, puzzle, and battle your way through the mystery unfolding in Stamets Point: your typical Pacific Northwest town at the center of monumental events.

  • OS: 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL-compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 850 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Recommended
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 native resolution
